bajra___Downy mildew.symptoms: Chlorosis on young leaves starting from base, white downy fungal growth on underside; earheads transformed into leafy structures.
bajra___Downy mildew.organic_treatment: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 10 g/kg; foliar spray of Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L; remove and rogue out infected green ears.
bajra___Downy mildew.chemical_treatment: Seed dressing with Metalaxyl 35% WS @ 6 g/kg seed; spray Metalaxyl-Mancozeb (Ridomil MZ) @ 2.5 g/L at 20 and 35 DAS.
bajra___Downy mildew.cultural_prevention: Grow resistant cultivars (HHB 67 Improved); avoid waterlogging; destroy crop residue.

bajra___Ergot.symptoms: Honey-like pinkish/amber sticky droplets oozing from florets, later solidifying into dark brown/black sclerotia containing toxic alkaloids.
bajra___Ergot.organic_treatment: Dip seeds in 10% brine solution (100 g common salt in 1 L water) and skim off floating ergot sclerotia; spray Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) 5%.
bajra___Ergot.chemical_treatment: Foliar spray of Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1 g/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L at early boot-leaf and flowering stage.
bajra___Ergot.cultural_prevention: Early sowing to escape humid flowering periods; deep summer plowing to bury sclerotia below 5 cm.

bajra___Smut.symptoms: Infected florets form enlarged green oval sori, turning dark brown/black and releasing powdery soot-like chlamydospores.
bajra___Smut.organic_treatment: Seed soaking in hot water at 52°C for 10 minutes; apply Trichoderma harzianum @ 5 g/kg seed.
bajra___Smut.chemical_treatment: Seed treatment with Carboxin 75% WP @ 2 g/kg seed; spray Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2 g/L during head emergence.
bajra___Smut.cultural_prevention: Rotate with pulses; avoid excessive late nitrogen applications.

bajra___rust.symptoms: Small, pinhead-sized reddish-brown to orange uredinial pustules covering upper leaf blades, turning dark black-brown at maturity.
bajra___rust.organic_treatment: Spray Wettable Sulfur 80% WDG @ 3 g/L or 3% fermented sour buttermilk (chaas).
bajra___rust.chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L at first sign of pustules.
bajra___rust.cultural_prevention: Eradicate alternate host weeds (Solanum torvum); ensure optimum spacing.

bajra___helathy.symptoms: Erect, vibrant green lanceolate leaves with robust tillers and normal boot leaf formation.
bajra___helathy.organic_treatment: Maintain balanced fertility with Jeevamrit @ 200 L/acre monthly or Panchagavya 3% foliar spray.
bajra___helathy.chemical_treatment: No fungicide or pesticide needed. Follow standard basal N-P-K recommendation (80:40:40 kg/ha).
bajra___helathy.cultural_prevention: Timely weeding at 20 and 40 DAS; maintain soil aeration.

bengal gram___Ascochyta blight.symptoms: Circular brown lesions on leaves and pods with concentric rings of minute black fruiting bodies (pycnidia); stem girdling causes breakage.
bengal gram___Ascochyta blight.organic_treatment: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 8 g/kg seed; foliar spray of Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L.
bengal gram___Ascochyta blight.chemical_treatment: Seed dressing with Carbendazim 2 g/kg; foliar spray of Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2 g/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1 ml/L.
bengal gram___Ascochyta blight.cultural_prevention: Intercrop with Barley or Mustard; use clean certified disease-free seed.

bengal gram___Botrytis gray mold.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on stems, leaves, and flowers rapidly covered by fluffy gray fungal mycelium and mass of conidia; flower drop.
bengal gram___Botrytis gray mold.organic_treatment: Spray baking soda (potassium bicarbonate) @ 5 g/L with liquid soap; improve canopy airflow.
bengal gram___Botrytis gray mold.chemical_treatment: Foliar spray of Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP (Saaf) @ 2 g/L or Iprodione 50% WP @ 2 g/L.
bengal gram___Botrytis gray mold.cultural_prevention: Avoid dense sowing; wider row spacing (45 cm); avoid flood irrigation during flowering.

bengal gram___Fusarium wilt.symptoms: Sudden drooping of petioles and leaflets starting from apex, vascular browning seen when stem is split vertically.
bengal gram___Fusarium wilt.organic_treatment: Soil incorporation of Trichoderma viride enriched Farm Yard Manure (FYM) @ 2.5 kg/ton FYM per acre.
bengal gram___Fusarium wilt.chemical_treatment: Seed dressing with Carbendazim 50% WP @ 2 g/kg + Thiram @ 2 g/kg seed.
bengal gram___Fusarium wilt.cultural_prevention: Crop rotation with sorghum, pearl millet, or wheat for 3 years; sow wilt-resistant varieties (JG 11, JAKI 9218).

bengal gram___Rust.symptoms: Small brownish, powdery eruptive pustules on lower leaf surface, turning dark brown; premature defoliation.
bengal gram___Rust.organic_treatment: Foliar spray of Wettable Sulfur @ 3 g/L or 5% Neem extract.
bengal gram___Rust.chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L.
bengal gram___Rust.cultural_prevention: Avoid late sowing; destroy self-sown chickpea weeds.

bengal gram___HEALTHY.symptoms: Uniform lush green compound leaves with healthy glandular hairs and active nodulation on roots.
bengal gram___HEALTHY.organic_treatment: Inoculate seeds with Rhizobium and PSB biofertilizers; apply 3% Panchagavya at vegetative stage.
bengal gram___HEALTHY.chemical_treatment: No pesticides required. Maintain recommended 20:50:20 kg N:P2O5:K2O/ha.
bengal gram___HEALTHY.cultural_prevention: Proper drainage; nipping of apical buds at 30-40 DAS to promote branching.

black gram___Cercospora leaf spot.symptoms: Small circular brown spots with grayish white centers and reddish-brown margins on leaves.
black gram___Cercospora leaf spot.organic_treatment: Spray 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) or Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L.
black gram___Cercospora leaf spot.chemical_treatment: Spray Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1 g/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L at first disease appearance.
black gram___Cercospora leaf spot.cultural_prevention: Destroy infected haulms; avoid overhead irrigation.

black gram___Powdery mildew.symptoms: White powdery fungal patches on upper surface of leaves, stems, and pods; yellowing and early leaf drop.
black gram___Powdery mildew.organic_treatment: Spray Wettable Sulfur 80% WDG @ 3 g/L or sour buttermilk (chaas) @ 50 ml/L.
black gram___Powdery mildew.chemical_treatment: Spray Dinocap 48% EC @ 1 ml/L or Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 2 ml/L.
black gram___Powdery mildew.cultural_prevention: Plant resistant cultivars (LBG 752, PU 31); avoid shade.

black gram___Web blight.symptoms: Large water-soaked irregular lesions on leaves resembling scald, web-like mycelial growth binding leaves together.
black gram___Web blight.organic_treatment: Soil application of Trichoderma viride enriched FYM @ 5 kg/acre.
black gram___Web blight.chemical_treatment: Spray Validamycin 3% L @ 2 ml/L or Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP @ 2 g/L.
black gram___Web blight.cultural_prevention: Avoid dense sowing; ensure proper drainage.

black gram___Yellow mosaic.symptoms: Irregular bright yellow and dark green mosaic patches on leaves, puckering and severe pod reduction.
black gram___Yellow mosaic.organic_treatment: Install yellow sticky traps @ 20/acre; spray Neem Oil 10,000 ppm @ 3 ml/L to suppress whiteflies.
black gram___Yellow mosaic.chemical_treatment: Seed treatment with Imidacloprid 70% WS @ 5 g/kg; spray Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.3 g/L or Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3 g/L.
black gram___Yellow mosaic.cultural_prevention: Sow YMV-tolerant varieties (LBG 752, LBG 787); rogue out early infected plants.

black gram___healthy.symptoms: Vigorous trifoliate deep green foliage, active root nodules, normal flowering.
black gram___healthy.organic_treatment: Foliar spray of 2% DAP or 1% Pulse Wonder at flower initiation.
black gram___healthy.cultural_prevention: Hand weeding at 20 DAS; maintain uniform field moisture.

CHILLI___Anthracnose.symptoms: Circular sunken spots on ripe red fruits with concentric rings of black acervuli; twig die-back from tip downwards.
CHILLI___Anthracnose.organic_treatment: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 10 g/kg; foliar spray of Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L twice at 10-day intervals.
CHILLI___Anthracnose.chemical_treatment: Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1 ml/L or Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 0.5 ml/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L.
CHILLI___Anthracnose.cultural_prevention: Collect and burn fallen infected fruits; avoid flood irrigation; use pathogen-free seed.

CHILLI___Bacterial leaf spot.symptoms: Small water-soaked circular to angular dark brown spots with chlorotic yellow borders; severe defoliation.
CHILLI___Bacterial leaf spot.organic_treatment: Foliar spray of cow dung slurry filtrate 20% mixed with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L.
CHILLI___Bacterial leaf spot.chemical_treatment: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L of water.
CHILLI___Bacterial leaf spot.cultural_prevention: Avoid working in wet fields; 2-year crop rotation with maize or sorghum.

CHILLI___Leaf curl.pathogen: Chilli leaf curl virus (ChiLCV) & Thrips / Mites
CHILLI___Leaf curl.symptoms: Upward curling and puckering of leaves, vein thickening, stunted bush-like growth with poor fruit set.
CHILLI___Leaf curl.organic_treatment: Install yellow and blue sticky traps (25/acre); spray Neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 3.5 ml/L + Agniastra @ 20 ml/L.
CHILLI___Leaf curl.chemical_treatment: Control vectors: Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.25 g/L or Fipronil 5% SC @ 1.5 ml/L or Spiromesifen 22.9% SC @ 1 ml/L.
CHILLI___Leaf curl.cultural_prevention: Grow 3-4 border rows of maize or bajra; use reflective silver plastic mulch.

CHILLI___Wilt.symptoms: Rapid yellowing and permanent wilting of foliage without premature leaf drop; vascular browning.
CHILLI___Wilt.organic_treatment: Drench root zone with Trichoderma viride @ 10 g/L or Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/L.
CHILLI___Wilt.chemical_treatment: Soil drenching with Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/L or Carbendazim @ 1 g/L around plant base.
CHILLI___Wilt.cultural_prevention: Provide raised bed planting; ensure good soil drainage.

CHILLI___healthy.symptoms: Lush emerald green foliage, erect growth, abundant healthy white flowers and smooth firm fruits.
CHILLI___healthy.organic_treatment: Spray 3% Panchagavya and Vermiwash (50 ml/L) alternately every 15 days.
CHILLI___healthy.chemical_treatment: No pesticides required. Maintain balanced fertigation (NPK 19:19:19).
CHILLI___healthy.cultural_prevention: Maintain 60x45 cm plant spacing; avoid water stagnation.

cotton___Anthracnose.symptoms: Reddish-brown water-soaked spots on seedlings, circular sunken lesions on bolls with pinkish spore mass.
cotton___Anthracnose.organic_treatment: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 10 g/kg; spray 5% NSKE.
cotton___Anthracnose.chemical_treatment: Spray Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1 g/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L.
cotton___Anthracnose.cultural_prevention: Acid delinting of cotton seeds; clean field sanitation.

cotton___Bacterial blight.symptoms: Angular water-soaked lesions bounded by leaf veinlets, black lesions on petioles (black arm), and sunken circular spots on bolls.
cotton___Bacterial blight.organic_treatment: Spray fresh cow urine distillate @ 20 ml/L + Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L.
cotton___Bacterial blight.chemical_treatment: Copper Oxychloride @ 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L at early vegetative stage.
cotton___Bacterial blight.cultural_prevention: Destruction of infected stalks; sow tolerant Bt-cotton hybrids.

cotton___Cotton leaf curl.pathogen: Cotton Leaf Curl Multan Virus (transmitted by Whitefly)
cotton___Cotton leaf curl.symptoms: Upward or downward leaf curling, thickening of veins, leaf-like enations on undersides of leaves, severe stunting.
cotton___Cotton leaf curl.organic_treatment: Yellow sticky traps @ 25/acre; spray Neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 3 ml/L or Lecanicillium lecanii @ 5 g/L.
cotton___Cotton leaf curl.chemical_treatment: Spray Pyriproxyfen 10% EC @ 2 ml/L or Spiromesifen 22.9% SC @ 1.25 ml/L or Afidopyropen 50 g/L @ 2 ml/L.
cotton___Cotton leaf curl.cultural_prevention: Eradicate weed hosts (Abutilon indicum); plant resistant hybrids.

cotton___Fusarium wilt.symptoms: Yellowing and browning starting at leaf margins, wilting, vascular discolouration visible as dark ring in stem.
cotton___Fusarium wilt.organic_treatment: Soil application of Trichoderma harzianum enriched neem cake @ 100 kg/acre.
cotton___Fusarium wilt.chemical_treatment: Seed treatment with Carbendazim 2 g/kg seed; drench with Carbendazim @ 1 g/L.
cotton___Fusarium wilt.cultural_prevention: Crop rotation with non-host crops (Sorghum, Pearl Millet); use resistant varieties.

cotton___healthy.symptoms: Vigorous dark green lobed leaves, strong square (bud) formation, healthy boll development.
cotton___healthy.organic_treatment: Foliar application of 1% 19:19:19 + 0.5% MgSO4 + 0.2% Boron at square formation.
cotton___healthy.cultural_prevention: Proper nipping at 80-90 DAS; keep rows clean of weeds.

green gram___Anthracnose.symptoms: Dark brown sunken circular lesions on leaves, stems, and pods with raised margins.
green gram___Anthracnose.organic_treatment: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 8 g/kg seed; spray Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L.
green gram___Anthracnose.chemical_treatment: Spray Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1 g/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L.
green gram___Anthracnose.cultural_prevention: Collect and burn plant debris; certified disease-free seeds.

green gram___Cercospora leaf spot.symptoms: Circular to subcircular dark brown spots with grayish white centers on leaflets.
green gram___Cercospora leaf spot.chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1 g/L.
green gram___Cercospora leaf spot.cultural_prevention: Intercrop with pearl millet or sorghum.

green gram___Powdery mildew.symptoms: White floury powdery coating spreading across leaves and pods, premature defoliation.
green gram___Powdery mildew.organic_treatment: Spray Wettable Sulfur @ 3 g/L or sour buttermilk 50 ml/L.
green gram___Powdery mildew.chemical_treatment: Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 2 ml/L or Dinocap 48% EC @ 1 ml/L.

green gram___Yellow mosaic.symptoms: Scattered yellow specks on young leaves developing into confluent bright yellow mosaic; stunted pods.
green gram___Yellow mosaic.organic_treatment: Install yellow sticky traps @ 20/acre; spray Neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 3 ml/L.
green gram___Yellow mosaic.chemical_treatment: Seed dressing with Imidacloprid 70% WS @ 5 g/kg; spray Acetamiprid @ 0.3 g/L.
green gram___Yellow mosaic.cultural_prevention: Rogue out early diseased plants; grow tolerant varieties (IPM 02-03).

green gram___healthy.symptoms: Lush vibrant green leaves, uniform flowering, healthy pod set.
green gram___healthy.organic_treatment: Spray 2% DAP or Pulse Wonder at 30 and 45 DAS.
green gram___healthy.cultural_prevention: Timely weeding; avoid water stress during pod filling.

ground nut___Collar rot.symptoms: Black sooty fungal spores covering hypocotyl/collar region, collar turns brown and decays, seedling wilts.
ground nut___Collar rot.organic_treatment: Seed treatment with Trichoderma harzianum @ 10 g/kg seed; application of neem cake @ 100 kg/acre.
ground nut___Collar rot.chemical_treatment: Seed dressing with Mancozeb @ 3 g/kg or Tebuconazole 2% DS @ 1.5 g/kg seed.
ground nut___Collar rot.cultural_prevention: Deep summer plowing; avoid sowing deep into wet soil.

ground nut___Early leaf spot.symptoms: Circular reddish-brown to dark brown spots surrounded by a prominent bright yellow chlorotic halo on upper leaf surface.
ground nut___Early leaf spot.organic_treatment: Foliar spray of 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) or Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L.
ground nut___Early leaf spot.chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 2 ml/L or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1 ml/L.
ground nut___Early leaf spot.cultural_prevention: Crop rotation with maize or sorghum; destroy plant debris.

ground nut___Late leaf spot.symptoms: Nearly circular, dark brown to black spots with inconspicuous yellow halos, cushion-like carbonaceous conidial masses on lower surface.
ground nut___Late leaf spot.organic_treatment: Spray 3% Panchagavya + Neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 3 ml/L.
ground nut___Late leaf spot.chemical_treatment: Spray Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2 g/L or Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP @ 2 g/L.
ground nut___Late leaf spot.cultural_prevention: Avoid continuous groundnut cropping; sow resistant cultivars (Kadiri 9, Kadiri Lepakshi).

ground nut___Rust.symptoms: Orange to reddish-brown blister-like pustules (uredinia) on lower leaf surface, leaving leaf brittle and dried.
ground nut___Rust.organic_treatment: Spray Wettable Sulfur 80% WDG @ 3 g/L or Trichoderma viride @ 5 g/L.
ground nut___Rust.chemical_treatment: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L or Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 2 ml/L.
ground nut___Rust.cultural_prevention: Eradicate volunteer groundnut plants; practice intercropping with pigeon pea.

ground nut___healthy.symptoms: Dense, dark green pinnate foliage with abundant yellow flowers and vigorous pegging into the soil.
ground nut___healthy.organic_treatment: Apply Gypsum @ 200 kg/acre at 40-45 DAS (flowering/pegging stage) for pod calcium.
ground nut___healthy.cultural_prevention: Earthing up during weeding before peg penetration; avoid disturbing pegs after 50 DAS.

jower___Anthracnose.symptoms: Small elliptical to circular red, purple or brown spots on leaves with straw-colored centers containing black fruiting bodies.
jower___Anthracnose.organic_treatment: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 8 g/kg seed; spray Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L.
jower___Anthracnose.chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1 ml/L.

jower___Grain mold.symptoms: Fluffy pinkish, black or white mold growth over ripening grain head during high humidity; grains become discolored and chalky.
jower___Grain mold.organic_treatment: Foliar spray of Neem extract 5% at flowering and milk stage.
jower___Grain mold.chemical_treatment: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L or Mancozeb @ 2.5 g/L at 50% flowering.
jower___Grain mold.cultural_prevention: Harvest promptly at physiological maturity; dry grain to <12% moisture.

jower___Rust.symptoms: Small purple, red, or brown spots on both leaf surfaces producing raised powdery rust-colored pustules.
jower___Rust.organic_treatment: Spray Wettable Sulfur @ 3 g/L or sour buttermilk 50 ml/L.
jower___Rust.chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Propiconazole @ 1 ml/L.
jower___Rust.cultural_prevention: Avoid dense sowing; destroy weed hosts (Johnson grass).

jower___Smut.symptoms: Normal grains replaced by oval conical gray-brown smut sori filled with powdery black fungal spores.
jower___Smut.organic_treatment: Seed soaking in hot water at 52°C for 10 min; treat seed with Trichoderma @ 5 g/kg.
jower___Smut.chemical_treatment: Seed dressing with Carboxin 75% WP @ 2 g/kg seed or Thiram @ 3 g/kg seed.
jower___Smut.cultural_prevention: Use certified seed only; field sanitation.

jower___healthy.symptoms: Sturdy stalks with broad emerald green leaves and compact well-filled grain panicles.
jower___healthy.organic_treatment: Side-dress with vermicompost @ 500 kg/acre and spray 3% Panchagavya.
jower___healthy.cultural_prevention: Ensure timely weeding at 20 and 40 DAS; maintain drainage.

maize___Common rust.symptoms: Golden brown to cinnamon-brown powdery elongated pustules bursting through both leaf surfaces; leaves turn chlorotic.
maize___Common rust.organic_treatment: Spray Wettable Sulfur 80% WDG @ 3 g/L or Trichoderma viride @ 5 g/L.
maize___Common rust.chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1 ml/L.
maize___Common rust.cultural_prevention: Plant rust-resistant hybrids; avoid late plantings.

maize___Downy mildew.symptoms: Narrow chlorotic yellow stripes extending along veins, white downy growth on leaf underside, abnormal tassel proliferation (crazy top).
maize___Downy mildew.organic_treatment: Seed treatment with Trichoderma harzianum @ 10 g/kg; rogue out infected plants.
maize___Downy mildew.chemical_treatment: Seed treatment with Metalaxyl 35% WS @ 4 g/kg seed; spray Metalaxyl + Mancozeb @ 2.5 g/L at 20 DAS.
maize___Downy mildew.cultural_prevention: Avoid planting near sorghum; avoid water stagnation.

maize___Gray leaf spot.symptoms: Distinct rectangular tan to gray lesions with sharp parallel edges restricted by veins, progressing upward from lower leaves.
maize___Gray leaf spot.organic_treatment: Foliar spray of Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L + Panchagavya 3%.
maize___Gray leaf spot.chemical_treatment: Spray Pyraclostrobin 20% WG @ 1 g/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1 ml/L or Mancozeb @ 2.5 g/L.
maize___Gray leaf spot.cultural_prevention: Crop rotation with soybean or pulses; deep tillage of corn stubble.

maize___Northern leaf blight.symptoms: Large, elongated cigar-shaped grayish-green to tan lesions (2.5 to 15 cm long) with concentric zones and dark spores.
maize___Northern leaf blight.organic_treatment: Spray 5% Neem extract + Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L.
maize___Northern leaf blight.chemical_treatment: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L at first lesion appearance.
maize___Northern leaf blight.cultural_prevention: Balanced fertilization (avoid excessive N and low K); rotate fields.

maize___healthy.symptoms: Wide arching dark green leaves, strong erect stalks, clean silk and tassel development.
maize___healthy.organic_treatment: Apply Jeevamrit @ 200 L/acre along with irrigation water at knee-high and tasseling stages.
maize___healthy.cultural_prevention: Maintain optimal plant population (24,000 plants/acre); ensure weed-free initial 45 days.

red garm___Alternaria blight.symptoms: Small circular necrotic brown spots with concentric rings surrounded by yellow halos on leaves, petioles, and pods.
red garm___Alternaria blight.organic_treatment: Spray 5% NSKE or Trichoderma viride @ 5 g/L.
red garm___Alternaria blight.chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2 g/L.
red garm___Alternaria blight.cultural_prevention: Avoid high density planting; destroy harvested crop residues.

red garm___Fusarium wilt.symptoms: Gradual yellowing and withering of leaves, purple discoloration band on stem starting from ground level, xylem discolored dark brown.
red garm___Fusarium wilt.organic_treatment: Soil application of Trichoderma viride enriched FYM @ 2.5 kg/ton FYM per acre.
red garm___Fusarium wilt.chemical_treatment: Seed dressing with Carbendazim 50% WP @ 2 g/kg + Thiram @ 2 g/kg seed.
red garm___Fusarium wilt.cultural_prevention: Intercrop with sorghum (which exudes hydrocyanic acid that suppresses Fusarium); 3-year crop rotation.

red garm___Phytophthora blight.symptoms: Brown to black water-soaked lesions on stems, girdling of main stem leading to rapid wilting and foliage desiccation.
red garm___Phytophthora blight.organic_treatment: Drench root zone with Trichoderma viride @ 10 g/L; improve field drainage.
red garm___Phytophthora blight.chemical_treatment: Seed treatment with Metalaxyl 35% WS @ 3 g/kg seed; spray Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold) @ 2.5 g/L.
red garm___Phytophthora blight.cultural_prevention: Ridge and furrow planting to avoid water stagnation.

red garm___Sterility mosaic.pathogen: Pigeonpea sterility mosaic virus (transmitted by Aceria cajani mite)
red garm___Sterility mosaic.symptoms: Severe stunting, excessive vegetative branching giving a bushy green appearance, mosaic mottling of leaves, total absence of flowers and pods.
red garm___Sterility mosaic.organic_treatment: Spray Wettable Sulfur 80% WDG @ 3 g/L or Neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 3 ml/L to control mite vector.
red garm___Sterility mosaic.chemical_treatment: Spray Fenazaquin 10% EC @ 1.5 ml/L or Propargite 57% EC @ 2 ml/L to control eriophyid mites.
red garm___Sterility mosaic.cultural_prevention: Grow resistant varieties (Asha - ICPL 87119, WRG 65); rogue out infected bushes early.

red garm___healthy.symptoms: Vigorous woody branching, deep green trifoliate leaves, profuse yellow-orange blossoms and clean pods.
red garm___healthy.organic_treatment: Spray 2% Urea or Pulse Wonder at 50% flowering to boost pod filling.
red garm___healthy.cultural_prevention: Nipping of main terminal shoots at 45 and 60 DAS to encourage lateral fruiting branches.

rice___Bacterial leaf blight.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on leaf margins turning wavy yellowish-white stripes drying to grayish-white; milky bacterial ooze droplets in morning.
rice___Bacterial leaf blight.organic_treatment: Spray fresh cow dung slurry filtrate 20% + Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L; drain stagnant water.
rice___Bacterial leaf blight.chemical_treatment: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.15 g/L.
rice___Bacterial leaf blight.cultural_prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer (split N application into 3 doses); use resistant varieties (Swarna-Sub1, BPT 5204 tolerant lines).

rice___Sheath blight.symptoms: Oval or elliptical greenish-gray water-soaked spots with dark brown margins on leaf sheaths just above water level, progressing upward.
rice___Sheath blight.organic_treatment: Soil application of Trichoderma viride @ 2.5 kg/acre in vermicompost; spray Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L.
rice___Sheath blight.chemical_treatment: Spray Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 2 ml/L or Validamycin 3% L @ 2 ml/L or Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1 ml/L.
rice___Sheath blight.cultural_prevention: Avoid close spacing; keep bunds weed-free; ensure balanced potash (K) application.

rice___brown spot.symptoms: Numerous small circular to oval brown spots with gray or whitish centers and yellowish halos resembling sesame seeds.
rice___brown spot.organic_treatment: Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/kg seed; foliar spray of 5% NSKE.
rice___brown spot.chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L.
rice___brown spot.cultural_prevention: Correct soil nutrient deficiencies (especially Potassium and Silicon); avoid drought stress.

rice___rice blast.symptoms: Spindle-shaped / diamond-shaped lesions with pointed ends, gray/white centers and dark brown borders; neck rot causes rotten neck and empty panicles.
rice___rice blast.organic_treatment: Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/kg; foliar spray of 3% Panchagavya + Neem oil.
rice___rice blast.chemical_treatment: Spray Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g/L or Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5 ml/L or Kasugamycin 3% SL @ 2.5 ml/L.
rice___rice blast.cultural_prevention: Avoid high doses of nitrogenous fertilizers; maintain continuous shallow water layer.

rice___healthy.symptoms: Erect, deep green leaves with clean leaf sheaths, vigorous tillering and heavy golden-yellow panicles.
rice___healthy.organic_treatment: Apply Azospirillum and PSB @ 2 kg/acre each; foliar spray of 1% 19:19:19 at panicle initiation.
rice___healthy.cultural_prevention: Alternate wetting and drying (AWD) irrigation to save water and stimulate deep rooting.

sugar cane___Grassy shoot.symptoms: Profuse tillering producing dense mass of thin, slender grassy shoots with chlorotic papery white/yellow leaves; stunted millable canes.
sugar cane___Grassy shoot.organic_treatment: Hot water treatment of seed setts at 50°C for 2 hours; rogue out infected grassy clumps.
sugar cane___Grassy shoot.chemical_treatment: Control sucking insect vectors: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.5 ml/L or Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3 g/L.
sugar cane___Grassy shoot.cultural_prevention: Use tissue-cultured disease-free planting material; avoid ratoon crops from infected mother cane.

sugar cane___Red rot.symptoms: Third and fourth leaves wither from tip downwards, split cane shows longitudinal red discolouration with distinct white transverse patches; alcohol smell.
sugar cane___Red rot.organic_treatment: Dip setts in Trichoderma viride slurry (10 g/L) for 30 min before planting; apply Trichoderma enriched FYM @ 5 kg/acre.
sugar cane___Red rot.chemical_treatment: Dip setts in Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1 g/L for 15 minutes before planting; foliar spray of Thiophanate Methyl 70% WP @ 1.5 g/L.
sugar cane___Red rot.cultural_prevention: Plant red-rot resistant varieties (Co 86032, Co 0238); avoid ratooning in infected plots; crop rotation with rice.

sugar cane___Smut.symptoms: Central stalk terminal shoot produces a long, whip-like unbranched curved structure covered with silver membrane that bursts releasing black soot.
sugar cane___Smut.organic_treatment: Carefully enclose smut whip in cloth bag, cut and destroy by burning; dip setts in hot water at 52°C for 30 minutes.
sugar cane___Smut.chemical_treatment: Dip setts in Triadimefon 25% WP @ 1 g/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L before planting.
sugar cane___Smut.cultural_prevention: Rogue out early whip-smut plants before spore dispersal; inspect seed nursery.

sugar cane___Wilt.symptoms: Canes become light, hollow and pithy; internal tissue shows diffuse dull reddish discoloration without white patches; crown leaves turn yellow and dry.
sugar cane___Wilt.organic_treatment: Soil drenching with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/L; incorporate press mud @ 5 tons/acre.
sugar cane___Wilt.chemical_treatment: Sett treatment with Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1 g/L; drench root zone with Carbendazim @ 1 g/L.
sugar cane___Wilt.cultural_prevention: Ensure good field drainage; avoid root damage by root grubs or nematodes.

sugar cane___healthy.symptoms: Robust thick stalks with lush green arching foliage, thick wax bloom on internodes, clean leaf sheaths.
sugar cane___healthy.organic_treatment: Apply Gluconacetobacter diazotrophicus (endophytic nitrogen fixer) @ 2 kg/acre; trash mulching between cane rows.
sugar cane___healthy.cultural_prevention: Detrashing of dry lower leaves at 150 and 210 DAS to improve aeration and prevent scale insects.

Pest___Spider Mites.symptoms: Fine yellow stippling and bronzing on upper leaf surface, delicate silken webbing on leaf undersides with active crawling tiny mites.
Pest___Spider Mites.organic_treatment: Foliar spray of cold-pressed Neem Oil (10,000 ppm) @ 3.5 ml/L with 1 ml detergent OR Karanja Oil @ 5 ml/L; release predatory mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis).
Pest___Spider Mites.chemical_treatment: Spiromesifen 22.9% SC @ 1.25 ml/L OR Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.25 g/L OR Propargite 57% EC @ 2 ml/L.
Pest___Spider Mites.cultural_prevention: Avoid water stress in crops (spider mites multiply in dry, hot weather); overhead misting suppresses mite colonies.

Pest___Aphids Colony Damage.symptoms: Dense clusters of soft-bodied pear-shaped insects on tender shoots and under leaves, leaf crinkling, sticky honeydew attracting black sooty mold.
Pest___Aphids Colony Damage.organic_treatment: Spray Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) 5% or soap water spray (10 g washing soap/L); encourage natural ladybird beetles.
Pest___Aphids Colony Damage.chemical_treatment: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.5 ml/L OR Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.4 g/L OR Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3 g/L.
Pest___Aphids Colony Damage.cultural_prevention: Install yellow sticky cards; avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer which causes succulent tender vegetative growth.

Pest___Cutworm / Caterpillar Chewing.symptoms: Irregular large holes chewed through leaves, skeletonized foliage, severed young seedlings at ground level, bored holes in pods and fruits.
Pest___Cutworm / Caterpillar Chewing.organic_treatment: Install Pheromone Traps @ 5/acre; spray Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) kurstaki @ 2 g/L OR Beauveria bassiana @ 5 g/L; spray NSKE 5%.
Pest___Cutworm / Caterpillar Chewing.chemical_treatment: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC (Coragen) @ 0.3 ml/L OR Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.5 g/L OR Flubendiamide 39.35% SC @ 0.4 ml/L.
Pest___Cutworm / Caterpillar Chewing.cultural_prevention: Deep summer plowing to expose pupae to birds; plant border rows of Castor or Marigold as trap crops.

Pest___Whitefly Infestation.symptoms: Tiny moth-like white powdery flies fluttering when disturbed; leaves turn mottled yellow, stunted growth, transmission of Geminiviruses.
Pest___Whitefly Infestation.organic_treatment: Install Yellow Sticky Traps @ 25/acre; spray Neem Oil 10,000 ppm @ 4 ml/L OR Lecanicillium lecanii @ 5 g/L.
Pest___Whitefly Infestation.chemical_treatment: Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.25 g/L OR Pyriproxyfen 10% EC @ 2 ml/L OR Afidopyropen 50 g/L @ 2 ml/L.
Pest___Whitefly Infestation.cultural_prevention: Grow barrier crops (Maize/Bajra); use silver reflective mulch to disorient incoming whiteflies.

Weed___Nutgrass Sedge.symptoms: Persistent perennial sedge with triangular stems, shiny dark green narrow leaves, and underground tuber network outcompeting crops.
Weed___Nutgrass Sedge.organic_treatment: Hand digging of underground tubers; repeated cycle hoeing; thick organic straw mulching (15 cm) or black polyethylene mulch.
Weed___Nutgrass Sedge.chemical_treatment: Post-emergence: Halosulfuron-methyl 75% WG (Sempra) @ 36 g/acre in 150 L water. For non-crop areas: Glyphosate 41% SL @ 10 ml/L.
Weed___Nutgrass Sedge.cultural_prevention: Deep summer plowing during hot May months to expose tubers to sunlight and heat desiccation.

Weed___Parthenium Congress Grass.symptoms: Invasive herbaceous weed with deeply dissected leaves and white flower heads; produces parthenin toxin inhibiting crop germination.
Weed___Parthenium Congress Grass.organic_treatment: Physical uprooting before flowering (wear gloves); biological control with Mexican leaf beetle (Zygogramma bicolorata).
Weed___Parthenium Congress Grass.chemical_treatment: Spray Metribuzin 70% WP @ 300 g/acre or 2,4-D Ethyl Ester 38% EC @ 1 L/acre on young actively growing weeds.
Weed___Parthenium Congress Grass.cultural_prevention: Maintain competitive smother crops; plant Cassia tora along field borders to suppress Parthenium.

Weed___Bermuda Grass / Grassy Weed.symptoms: Extensively creeping perennial grass forming dense fibrous sod through stolons and rhizomes, robbing soil moisture and nutrients.
Weed___Bermuda Grass / Grassy Weed.organic_treatment: Multiple passes of cultivator in dry summer to drag rhizomes to surface; cover cropping with dense cowpea or sunnhemp.
Weed___Bermuda Grass / Grassy Weed.chemical_treatment: In broadleaf crops: Quizalofop-ethyl 5% EC @ 300 ml/acre OR Fenoxaprop-p-ethyl 9.3% EC @ 350 ml/acre.
Weed___Bermuda Grass / Grassy Weed.cultural_prevention: Crop rotation with competitive puddle rice; solarization with transparent plastic sheets.
